h: Bruno Fernandes' home reportedly burgled during Manchester United's Champions League defeat
p: Burglars reportedly broke into the home of Manchester United captain Bruno Fernandes while the team was losing to Como in the Champions League.
more: The break-in was reported by several football outlets.
Police inquiries are said to be under way.
